decisions.name: Split
decisions.reason: The verified original UN WUP 2025 row identifies Split, Croatia, WUP code 549 at rank 3158 with 190315 persons. The earlier Croatia investigation made an explicit Split-area DGU WFS query and retained three full native polygons with safe parcel identifiers in the first-party response cache. A separate prior live-source review records Split queries, and the existing runtime city config names Split with the same DGU source. This is the same named Croatian settlement and a confirmed prior attempt, so WUP 549 remains excluded from pending fresh research. The immutable WUP point and row remain unchanged. The bounded response does not prove citywide coverage or satisfy the current independent admission gates; this identity decision does not newly qualify or admit the city.
